hook: Three men missing since July 29. Then a plane crew saw this.
narration: Three men had been missing since July 29. Then a plane crew saw this.
An S.O.S., dug into the sand of tiny Pikelot Island.
Their skiff had set out on a twenty-one mile trip, and never arrived.
An Air Force tanker crew spotted it on the final leg of their search.
Then a Coast Guard Hercules dropped them a radio and a message block.
That's a weighted note, for people with no radio.
outcome: The FSS Independence picked up all three, with no reported injuries.
title: SOS in the sand on a Pacific island
question_comment: What would you write in the sand if you were stranded?

description:
Three mariners missing since July 29, 2020, were found on Pikelot Island in the Federated States of Micronesia after an Air Force KC-135 crew spotted the S.O.S. they made on the beach. Coast Guard, Air Force, Royal Australian Navy and Micronesian responders worked the rescue.
